parsed.explanation: No trans-specific crime, facility ban, or border document regime is documented, and 2023 polling shows majority support for equal rights. Against this, a May 2026 police raid detaining ~30 people at an LGBTQ venue, with alleged warrantless entry, extortion and a baseless 'homosexuality' charge, plus post-2024-election persecution reporting, shows operative state targeting. No hate-crime or gender-identity anti-discrimination recourse is documented, so an outed visitor faces detention/extortion and impunity without a working remedy. Resident LGR absence is not counted as visitor exposure.

entry_documents.protection: No criminalisation of same-sex conduct; visitor uses home passport. No documented entry refusal for trans visitors.
entry_documents.interaction: No documented border screening or marker rule interacts with other factors.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: May 2026 raid detained ~30 people; extortion and false charge alleged. No documented prison placement rule.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Charge had no basis in national law, but no documented remedy or discipline reported.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Detention for venue presence could lead to extortion and outing, with no gender-identity recourse.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Not documented. No bathroom, ward or shelter rule by birth sex is in dossier.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Only subnational variation documented is the raid state; other regions not documented.

care_services.exposure: Not documented for visitors. No general healthcare/transition-care law is a resident gap, not visitor exposure.
care_services.interaction: Not documented whether emergency care would be denied after outing.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Police accused detainees of 'crime of homosexuality' despite no such law; gay parliamentarian held as prisoner of conscience in 2015; post-election persecution reported Sep 2024.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: National law does not criminalise same-sex conduct and age of consent is equal at 16.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Law-on-books protection is contradicted by enforcement practice in raid and political persecution.

minors_guardians.exposure: Not documented. No traveller-family rule documented; resident adoption/IVF law not visitor exposure.
minors_guardians.interaction: Not documented whether a minor travelling with a trans adult changes police or entry treatment.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Police themselves allegedly extorted and detained LGBTQ people; no hate-crime statute means no dedicated penalty for anti-trans violence/discrimination.
street_violence_police_response.protection: 2023 poll: majority say LGBTIQ+ should have same rights; government participates in Pride since 2000s, suggesting some social acceptance.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Acceptance does not offset documented police as perpetrator and absence of legal recourse.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No anti-discrimination or hate-crime recourse; 2016 anti-homophobia resolution suspended by supreme court; LGR action stalled - resident signal only.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Not documented that complaints against police in raid were investigated or remedied.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Institutional failure corroborates raid exposure; unknown whether procedure since created is deliberately not counted.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: police stops/interviews, extortion/fines, courts defer, detention rarely becomes imprisonment. This case has one documented raid/extortion with no remedy, but lacks routine universal stops, so not clearly below 0.35.

Lower: 0.55 has administrative delay/refusal with written decision, appeal desk and consular notice. Here police detention/extortion under a baseless charge and no gender-identity recourse is more severe, with no documented working remedy.

Higher: 0.25 has systematic transport-police extortion under vagrancy law plus overnight harassment and dismissed oversight. Here targeting is documented but no criminal statute, birth-sex custody, or routine extortion pattern is documented, and majority acceptance is present.

Much lower: 0.75 allows matching passport markers, trained officers, tribunal appeal and compensation. No such visitor-facing protection is documented here, and police raid/extortion is documented instead.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime: formal non-criminalisation and majority acceptance lower risk, but operative enforcement - warrantless venue raid, extortion, false charge, post-election persecution, and no hate-crime/anti-discrimination recourse - is the traveller-facing reality if outed. No universal facility, border or custody exposure is documented, preventing a lower score, and absent resident LGR machinery is not deducted. Result is Elevated Risk, just above the routine state-harassment anchor tier.
